post.summary: Atomically create one project and its original actor's first Administrator membership, or replay its original creation.
post.description: Requires fresh active organization admission and an explicit project-creation capability, independent of existing project roles. The document contains exactly the case-sensitive string properties name and description; both are required, unknown and duplicate fields are rejected. The strict UTF-8 entity is limited to 65536 bytes with no BOM, comments, trailing commas or decompression. Name is trimmed once and limited to 1–200 Unicode scalars and 800 UTF-8 bytes; description is preserved exactly and limited to 4000 scalars and 16000 UTF-8 bytes. Neither permits NUL or invalid Unicode. Only an optional UTF-8 charset and absent or one identity Content-Encoding are supported. No query, If-Match or If-None-Match fields are supported. One canonical nonzero lowercase UUID Idempotency-Key is required. Fresh capability admission and bounded immediate work admission precede body consumption; the final short atomic operation rechecks authority. 201 means actual creation and 200 exact replay after commit; changed intent or another actor's key is opaque 409. Initial membership facts are historical and never establish current project access or repair a revoked membership.

Read the current selected projection report for one immutable revision.
get.description: Requires fresh project ReadMetadata authority for the exact actor and full revision ancestry; all four project roles qualify. Enabled features are independent of organization project-creation capability and upload authority. All route and query UUIDs are canonical nonzero lowercase D strings. Unknown, repeated and escaped-duplicate query names are rejected; no actor, digest, backend profile, policy or private object inputs are accepted. No body or Content-Type is supported. Content-Encoding is absent or one identity token, Transfer-Encoding is absent, and Content-Length is zero or the server proves no body. Unknown/chunked/nonempty framing is rejected before body consumption. Conditional headers and Idempotency-Key are unsupported. Reads never derive, claim, repair, provision storage or start a worker. Current selects the server's full report key for this revision, independently of the mapping head. No query is accepted. Lifecycle, backend status and read refusal are separate. False validation is a usable report. Missing, corrupt, unsupported or over-budget selected payloads retain honest available metadata with a categorical read refusal and null report. The complete wrapper including linked findings is bounded before response bytes and followed by fresh authority/source validation. Local work/read admission is nonwaiting 429; report dependency availability is closed 503. A ResourceLimit wrapper that cannot fit its policy uses a fixed categorical 503 error of at most 1024 bytes. All responses are no-store and carry no ETag.

parameters.name: Content-Encoding
